invariants: No invented dose, duration, guide, sample size, result, protocol, or local capability
Experimental design factors remain distinct from machine-learning hyperparameters
Target engagement is required before attributing a phenotype to the intended target
Cells, fields, wells, sections, repeated measures, and technical replicates are not automatically independent biological units
Exploratory dose-time selection is frozen before confirmatory evaluation
Association, perturbation response, specificity, rescue, and translation have distinct claim ceilings
Human-subjects, animal-welfare, and biosafety-biosecurity approvals are independent and remain with authorized current local owners
Negative results, failures, exclusions, attrition, and deviations remain visible
Single laboratory cases retain applicability and counterexample boundaries and are never generalized into universal truth
